title: Validation of a New Shortness of Breath With Daily Activities Questionnaire in Patients With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate a new questionnaire to capture the patient experience of COPD. The information collected will be used to validate the Shortness of Breath with Daily Activities Questionnaire.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults ≥ 40 years of age
* Established clinical history of COPD by ATS/ERS definition
* Former or current smoker \> 10 pack years
* Evidence of dyspnea

Exclusion Criteria:

* Has a respiratory disorder other than COPD
* Cancer not in complete clinical remission
* Clinically significant cardiovascular, neurological, psychiatric, renal, gastro-intestinal, immunological, endocrine, or hematological abnormalities that are uncontrolled
